description: Source file defining a Mailer class that implements Symfony's MailerInterface. It encapsulates the SymfonyMailer to send email messages using a transport. The class provides a constructor to initialize the mailer with a transport and a send method to dispatch messages.

classes.name: Mailer
classes.description: A custom implementation of MailerInterface that wraps Symfony's Mailer. It manages email sending through dependency injection of a transport.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the Mailer with a specified transport, initializing an internal SymfonyMailer instance.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an email message using the internal SymfonyMailer, optionally with an envelope.
